title: Agent Bazaar: register an on-chain agent identity
summary: Initialise the protocol with a platform fee, register an agent, and see why fee_bps=10001 is rejected.
what: Agent Bazaar is an Anchor 0.31 program for an on-chain agent registry (identity + reputation). This lesson covers initialize and register_agent. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed on-chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-bazaar/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-bazaar/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize and register_agent campus-scout are already done.

diagram: authority --initialize--> protocol ["protocol"] ; owner --register_agent--> identity ["agent", count] + reputation ["reputation", count]
instructions: update/deactivate/feedback ixs exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A public on-chain identity and reputation registry for AI agents.
not_covered: update_agent, deactivate/reactivate/close, update_fee and submit_feedback were not exercised.
build: Anchor 0.31.1 program at 4JLHcJkEhBWxb8g9m5uZVjavS7vjhJ9yAVHUeShvM2Tx on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
